Board swap approval, DEC-579, 2026-09-01
sources.detail: Interaction 3e634d52, question swap-stampede, option accept. IN Smothering Tithe, OUT Hordeling Outburst. Treasures are tokens, so Tithe funds all three Baylen activations and fires at least three times per turn cycle (one per opponent draw step). It also turns on Bennie Bracks on opponents’ end steps and is doubled by Anointed Procession, Parallel Lives, and Mondrak. Metrics: global health 84→85, role coverage 86→88, cohesion 55→53. Game Changers 6→7 (bracket 4-, uncapped). Trade-off on record: Hordeling’s three goblins were creatures (Skullclamp fodder, convoke, blockers); Treasures are not.

sources.name: Board swap approval, DEC-580, 2026-09-01
sources.detail: Confirmation c74f1afd, accepted. IN Drumbellower, OUT Dragon Fodder. Drumbellower is a second creature-untap engine alongside Seedborn Muse: it untaps all your creatures during each other player's untap step (×3 per turn cycle), refueling Baylen and Prosperous Partnership off-turn. Dragon Fodder was the sorcery-speed twin of Raise the Alarm (same two-token output for two mana, no Goblin/Soldier typal payoff in the 99); the instant stays per board comment. Skullclamp synergy re-pointed from Dragon Fodder to Raise the Alarm.

sources.name: Board swap approval, DEC-685, 2026-09-07
sources.detail: Interaction 89eecf15, accepted, all lines ticked. IN Gleaming Splendor, OUT Raise the Alarm; IN The Queen of Dale, OUT Parallel Lives. Splendor is the single missing card in the tracked Smothering Tithe + doubler Spellbook lines (three of four lines remain after the Parallel Lives cut: Anointed Procession, Mondrak, Elspeth, Storm Slayer). Queen of Dale recruits on each opponent's first noncreature spell each turn (2-3 triggers per turn cycle at a 4-player table), making roughly 1-2 untapped Soldiers per cycle plus loot filtering — replacing Raise the Alarm's one-shot two tokens as early Baylen fuel. Parallel Lives cut as the twin doubler (text-identical to Anointed Procession); doubler consistency P(>=1 in first 13 cards) drops ~44% to ~35% on record. Skullclamp synergy re-pointed from Raise the Alarm to The Queen of Dale. Metrics: global health 85->85, role coverage 88->89, curve 98->99, gaps unchanged. Game Changers unchanged at 7 (bracket 4-, uncapped).

sources.name: Board swap approval, DEC-929, 2026-09-28
sources.detail: Interaction 5531eafc, question visitor_cut, option wedding. IN Draconic Visitor, OUT Wedding Announcement. Visitor converts every artifact-token event (Smothering Tithe, Gleaming Splendor, Prosperous Partnership, Rosie Cotton's Food, Anim Pakal's Gnome artifact tokens) into 5/5 flying Dragon creature tokens, which the deck's creature-token payoffs and multipliers all see. Frontline Rush was withdrawn as the cut on the board's early-curve concern: only Rush and Staff of the Storyteller make bodies unconditionally at two mana. Wedding Announcement was the slowest payoff (one 1/1 or one card per end step for three turns, then an anthem) and sits below the listed cutoff on Baylen's EDHREC page. Felidar Retreat was the offered alternative. Rejected for Hoard and Bleed: 19 of its 99 make or use artifact tokens, and Smaug's draw needs Treasure mana.

sources.name: Board swap approval, DEC-931, 2026-09-29
sources.detail: Verdict card 682b6545, lines E and F accepted. IN Rockfall Vale, OUT Jungle Shrine; IN Overgrown Farmland, OUT Path of Ancestry. Both slow lands enter untapped once two other lands are on the battlefield, replacing an always-tapped tri-land and a scry land whose creature-type clause was dead (no second Rabbit or Warrior in the 99). Untapped lands 35 to 37 of 37; sim manaReliability 70.7 to 71.6; manabase health 76 to 78; global health 85 unchanged. Third board-approved round since DEC-581, which fired Trigger-2 (DEC-933).

sources.name: Board swap approval, DEC-933, 2026-09-29
sources.detail: Verdict card 031e35bb, accepted. IN Peregrin Took, OUT Felidar Retreat. Took's replacement adds a Food token to every token-creation event (3-7 per turn cycle once two engines are online: Smothering Tithe on each opponent's draw step, The Queen of Dale recruits, own-turn producers and attacks); three Foods are a card through Baylen's draw ability or Took's own sacrifice, and each Food is a Rosie Cotton trigger and Baylen mana fuel. With Draconic Visitor out each Food becomes a 5/5 flying Dragon instead. Felidar Retreat fired on own land drops only (about 1.1 per cycle) for a 2/2 Cat or counters plus vigilance; vigilance also worked against Halo Fountain's tapped-creature costs. Trade-off on record: Retreat's Cats were creature bodies (ETB pings, Craterhoof) on an enchantment; Took is a creature and dies to Hour of Reckoning. Applied inside the DEC-933 Trigger-2 reset, so the swap-round counter stays at 0.

guideContent.strategyOverview: Baylen, the Haymaker is a Naya (RGW) go-wide tokens deck. Baylen doesn't make tokens himself — he consumes a wide board, tapping untapped tokens to ramp into any color, draw cards, and grow with trample. The 99 flood the board with unconditional and instant-speed token makers, multiply them with doublers, and convert the swarm into damage through ETB pingers, anthems, and overrun. A compact combo (Scurry Oak + Rosie Cotton) provides infinite-token inevitability that turns lethal alongside Impact Tremors or Purphoros, while repeatable Flurry engines (Cori-Steel Cutter, Aligned Heart) and instant-speed makers keep the board refilling.

deckCategories.name: Token Producers
deckCategories.description: Unconditional and instant-speed makers that flood the board from an empty start — several can fire on opponents' turns.

deckCategories.name: Token Multipliers
deckCategories.description: Static multipliers that turn every maker into an exponential flood.

deckCategories.name: Token Payoffs & Anthems
deckCategories.description: Convert width into damage — ETB pingers fire per token, anthems push the swarm through.

deckCategories.name: Baylen's Engine
deckCategories.description: Card advantage and untap effects that refuel the swarm and let Baylen tap the board for mana, cards, and pressure — plus recursion that rebuilds the engine after a wipe.

deckCategories.name: Overrun & Combo Finishes
deckCategories.description: Close the game: two one-shot overrun lords (trample and flying) and an infinite-token combo (Scurry Oak + Rosie Cotton) that turns lethal with any ETB pinger.

deckCategories.name: Interaction
deckCategories.description: Clean spot removal, two asymmetric wipes that spare our tokens, and board protection.

winConditions.name: Go-wide overrun
winConditions.description: A wide token board plus a one-shot pump from Craterhoof Behemoth (trample) or Moonshaker Cavalry (flying) swings for lethal in a single attack; Worldly Tutor fetches either, Natural Order fetches Craterhoof; Warleader's Call adds reach.

winConditions.name: Infinite tokens — Scurry Oak line
winConditions.description: Whenever you create a token, Rosie Cotton puts a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak, which makes a 1/1 green Squirrel — itself a token — looping infinitely. With Impact Tremors, Purphoros, or Warleader's Call on board, each Squirrel entering deals 1 damage to each opponent: infinite damage.

winConditions.name: Halo Fountain alternate win
winConditions.description: On a wide board, pay {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}, tap Halo Fountain, and untap fifteen tapped creatures you control to win the game outright. Fountain's costs need tapped creatures, so Baylen's tap abilities and attacks set it up rather than vigilance; Seedborn Muse untaps the Fountain on each opponent's turn for its token and draw modes.

synergies.title: Baylen converts a wide board into mana, cards, and reach
synergies.description: Every extra token is more fuel for Baylen's tap abilities (2 tokens = any-color mana, 3 = draw, 4 = +3/+3 trample). Doublers multiply both the swarm and Baylen's activations.

synergies.title: Scurry Oak + Rosie Cotton = infinite tokens
synergies.description: Each Squirrel Scurry Oak makes is a token, so Rosie Cotton puts a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak, which makes another Squirrel — a mana-free infinite loop.

synergies.title: Flurry Monks feed the ETB-pinger + doubler engine
synergies.description: Each Flurry trigger makes a 1/1 Monk; every Monk is a token (multiplied by Anointed Procession/Mondrak) and a creature ETB that pings with Impact Tremors/Purphoros and grows Scurry Oak via Rosie Cotton. Cori-Steel Cutter's equip hands a single Monk haste + trample to push damage through.

synergies.title: ETB pingers scale with token doublers
synergies.description: Impact Tremors and Purphoros fire for every creature that enters; doublers multiply each token wave, multiplying the damage independent of creature power.

synergies.title: Seedborn Muse lets Baylen and instant-makers work every turn
synergies.description: Untapping all permanents on each opponent's turn means Baylen taps the board around the table and instant-speed makers (Secure the Wastes, Grand Crescendo) flash in blockers and fuel. Drumbellower is the redundant copy of the effect for creatures — it untaps all your creatures during each other player's untap step, so token fuel comes back for Baylen three extra times per turn cycle even when Seedborn Muse is answered.

synergies.title: Skullclamp turns 1/1 tokens into card advantage
synergies.description: Equipping Skullclamp to a 1/1 token kills it and draws two — a relentless draw engine. The Queen of Dale restocks the fodder: her recruit trigger on each opponent's first noncreature spell makes a 1/1 Soldier whenever the discard is a nonland card.

synergies.title: Token creation feeds board-independent draw
synergies.description: Bennie Bracks (each end step) and Idol of Oblivion (tap) draw off the near-automatic token-per-turn stream without spending the board, while their casts and Clues/Food still count as Baylen fuel — draw that survives losing the commander. Smothering Tithe widens the stream to opponents' turns: each opponent draw makes a Treasure unless they pay {2}, so Bennie can draw at every end step, not only ours.

sources.name: EDHREC — Smothering Tithe 30.6% inclusion on Baylen

synergies.title: Draconic Visitor turns every artifact token into a 5/5 flyer
synergies.description: Visitor replaces any artifact token you would create with that many 5/5 red Dragon creature tokens with flying. Anim Pakal's Gnomes are artifact creature tokens, so each attack creates X Dragons instead (X grows by one per attack, and the Dragons are not Gnomes, so they keep triggering her). Smothering Tithe and Gleaming Splendor turn opponents' draws into Dragons, and Prosperous Partnership taps three creatures for a Dragon at instant speed for no mana. Every Dragon is a creature token, so Impact Tremors, Purphoros, Caretaker's Talent and Belladonna Took fire on it, and Anointed Procession, Mondrak and Elspeth double it. Cost: Treasures stop (Baylen still taps two tokens for one mana), and The Battle of Bywater kills Visitor and every Dragon. Peregrin Took adds a Food to every token-creation event, so with Visitor out each event also makes a 5/5 Dragon; without Visitor the Foods are Baylen fuel and Took's own draw (sacrifice three Foods: draw a card).
